rules: Headings (h1-h3) must use Manrope, weight 600 or 700.
Body text, tables, and inputs must use IBM Plex Sans.
Use tracking-tight (-0.02em) for headings larger than 24px.
Use tracking-wide (0.05em) for uppercase labels (e.g., table headers, badges).
Dashboard must use a dense grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4).
Widgets must stretch to fill height (h-full).
Sidebar must be fixed on the left (w-64) for desktop.
Main content area must have a subtle background color (#F8FAFC) to differentiate from white cards.

cards.classes: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-lg shadow-none hover:border-slate-300 transition-colors

buttons.primary: bg-slate-900 text-white hover:bg-slate-800 rounded-md px-4 py-2 font-medium transition-all active:scale-95
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-slate-900 border border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-50 rounded-md px-4 py-2 font-medium transition-all
buttons.accent: bg-[#D4AF37] text-white hover:bg-[#C5A028] rounded-md px-4 py-2 font-medium

inputs.classes: bg-white border-slate-200 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-slate-900 focus:border-transparent rounded-md

login_background.usage: Full screen background for Login page with overlay

qr_illustration.usage: Hero image for QR Management section or empty state

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-md bg-white/80 border-b border-white/20 (Use only for sticky headers)
visual_enhancers.texture: Add a subtle noise texture to the sidebar background to reduce sterility.
visual_enhancers.animation: Use 'framer-motion' for page transitions and list entrance animations (staggerChildren).

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. INSTALL FONTS: Add the Google Fonts import to public/index.html or src/index.css immediately.
2. SETUP THEME: Update tailwind.config.js and src/index.css with the provided CSS variables and colors.
3. LAYOUT: Create a 'DashboardLayout' component that includes the Sidebar and Topbar. Use the 'Bento Grid' philosophy for the main content area.
4. WHATSAPP SIMULATOR: Build this as a split-screen view. Left side: Chat Interface (mimic WhatsApp UI). Right side: Debug/Context panel (showing JSON data, user state).
5. BILL PROCESSING: Create a 'Queue' view. Left: List of pending bills. Right: Detail view with the bill image and OCR data fields side-by-side.
6. USE SHADCN: Use Shadcn components for all interactive elements (Forms, Dialogs, Dropdowns) but override their default styling to match the 'Flat & Clean' aesthetic defined in 'components'.
7. DATA-TESTID: Ensure every button, input, and link has a unique data-testid attribute.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for overlays.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
